pulseq_element.pulseq.name: pulseq_element.pulseq
pulseq_element.pulseq.script:
# Pulseq sequence file
# Created by PyPulseq
# PARAMETERS_JSON_START
# {
#   "grad_ramp":    { "type": "int",   "default": 200,  "min": 0,"max": 500, "step": 10, "unit": "us", "pulseq_value": 200, "pulseq_unit": "us", "description":"ramp up and down time" },
#   "grad_flat":    { "type": "int",   "default": 5000, "min": 0,"max": 200000, "step": 10, "unit": "us", "pulseq_value": 5000, "pulseq_unit": "us", "description":"flattop time"  },
#   "gradX_amp":    { "type": "float", "default": 9.394964, "min": -40.0, "max": 40.0, "step": 0.1, "unit": "mT/m", "pulseq_value": 400000,  "pulseq_unit": "Hz/m", "description":"gradient amplitude in x direction" },
#   "gradY_amp":    { "type": "float", "default": 9.394964, "min": -40.0, "max": 40.0, "step": 0.1, "unit": "mT/m", "pulseq_value": 400000,  "pulseq_unit": "Hz/m", "description":"gradient amplitude in y direction" },
#   "gradZ_amp":    { "type": "float", "default": 9.394964, "min": -40.0, "max": 40.0, "step": 0.1, "unit": "mT/m", "pulseq_value": 400000,  "pulseq_unit": "Hz/m", "description":"gradient amplitude in z direction" }
# }
# PARAMETERS_JSON_END

[VERSION]
major 1
minor 4
revision 2

[DEFINITIONS]
AdcRasterTime 1e-07 
BlockDurationRaster 1e-05 
GradientRasterTime 0.0001 
RadiofrequencyRasterTime 1e-06 
TotalDuration {(2*grad_ramp+grad_flat)*1e-6} 

# Format of blocks:
# NUM DUR RF  GX  GY  GZ  ADC  EXT
[BLOCKS]
1  {int((2*grad_ramp+grad_flat)/10)}   0   1   2   3  0  0

# Format of trapezoid gradients:
# id amplitude rise flat fall delay
# ..      Hz/m   us   us   us    us
[TRAP]
 1 {int(gradX_amp)} {grad_ramp} {grad_flat} {grad_ramp}   0
 2 {int(gradY_amp)} {grad_ramp} {grad_flat} {grad_ramp}   0
 3 {int(gradZ_amp)} {grad_ramp} {grad_flat} {grad_ramp}   0
